newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures drift lower in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures drift lower in moderate trade.

text.p: UK grain futures closed lower on Tuesday after moderate turnover.
"The market is drifting owing to a continuing lack of demand," said a trader.
Traders said lower Chicago soybean futures were having some effect on prices as soybeans become more competitive.
"Falling soybean prices are not a major factor at the moment but it is something else to think about on an already weak looking market," said another trader.
Wheat futures closed 0.15 to 0.50 stg down after trading 629 lots while barley was 0.25 to 0.50 stg lower on 145 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were again neglected.
Traders said business on the cash market has picked up slightly as the futures drift lower, but tonnages remain low.
On the fob market Mar feed wheat fetched 109 stg a tonne ex-east coast ports.
Delivered trade was slow with feed wheat fetching around 104.50 to 105 stg in the nearby positions and 108.50 to 109 stg next year.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein was fetching 123 to 125 stg this year and 126 stg for the early part of 1997.
Feed barley was making between 105.50 and 106 stg up to the end of the year with no business reported further forward.
